sections.heading: Who is buying from Mistral in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: The Department of Defense obligated $213M from Mistral in FY2026 to date. The Department of Justice obligated $7.4K. The buyer footprint is heavily weighted toward defense procurement, with the Department of Defense accounting for the vast majority of obligations.

sections.heading: What is Mistral selling to the government right now?
sections.body: Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing is the largest market for Mistral at $191M. Aircraft Manufacturing is the second-largest market at $22.5M, followed by Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Repair and Maintenance at $15.1K and Irradiation Apparatus Manufacturing at $7.4K. Those NAICS markets reflect the product and parts focus of Mistral’s federal work.
